newsitem.title: USA: Springs Industries names Bowles president.
newsitem.headline: Springs Industries names Bowles president.

text.p: Springs Industries said it named Crandall Bowles its president and chief operating officer, effective immediately.
The positions had formerly been held by Walter Elisha, the company's chairman and chief executive, a company spokesman said.
Bowles has been executive vice president of the company and president of Springs' Bath Fashions Group for the past two years, the company said.
Her great-great grandfather was among the company's foundeers in 1887, the company said.
